note: Raw Gurobi results for the bundled synthetic data under the default covenant terms. Served only when no live solver is reachable, and re-checked by the exact engine every time it is served.

sources.quote: Leverage is gross debt divided by trailing twelve-month EBITDA, maximum 3.00.
Asset sales: net proceeds of a permitted asset sale must repay debt, and the EBITDA and cash flow of the asset sold are removed from the trailing twelve-month figures.
DSCR is trailing twelve-month available cash flow divided by trailing twelve-month debt service, minimum 1.20.
Prepayment: a voluntary prepayment pays the stated premium and reduces trailing twelve-month debt service by the stated amount per dollar repaid.
Equity cure: the sponsor may contribute cash that is added to EBITDA and to available cash flow for the quarter tested, up to the equity cure cap in cure_terms.csv.
Cure frequency: an equity cure may be used only while cures remaining in the last four fiscal quarters is at least 1.
Minimum liquidity: after any voluntary prepayment the borrower must keep cash of at least the minimum liquidity in cure_terms.csv.
Current Ratio is current assets divided by current liabilities at quarter end, minimum 1.25.

Cure cash: a voluntary prepayment and its premium are paid from cash and reduce current assets, equity cure cash is not added to current assets, and the sale cost of a permitted asset sale is paid from its gross proceeds.

Prepayment: a voluntary prepayment pays the stated premium and reduces trailing twelve-month debt service by the stated amount per dollar repaid.
Equity cure: the sponsor may contribute cash that is added to EBITDA and to available cash flow for the quarter tested, up to the equity cure cap in cure_terms.csv.
Cure frequency: an equity cure may be used only while cures remaining in the last four fiscal quarters is at least 1.
Minimum liquidity: after any voluntary prepayment the borrower must keep cash of at least the minimum liquidity in cure_terms.csv.
Current Ratio is current assets divided by current liabilities at quarter end, minimum 1.25.

Cure cash: a voluntary prepayment and its premium are paid from cash and reduce current assets, equity cure cash is not added to current assets, and the sale cost of a permitted asset sale is paid from its gross proceeds.

Fixed Charge Coverage Ratio is trailing twelve-month EBITDA less unfinanced capital expenditures, cash taxes and distributions, divided by trailing twelve-month fixed charges (scheduled interest and principal), minimum 1.10.
